text:
emma_support: FYI escalating a customer billing question. They say SDK estimator (js v0.9.2) shows ~950 tokens but billing dashboard shows 1,245. Customer claims no streaming and simple chat flow. Screenshot + payload attached. Can eng check? :thinking:

alex_sre: Do we have the API request-id from the customer and model name? Also confirm streaming vs non-streaming.

emma_support: They provided request-id `req_01GkL9XyZ` and model `redwood-3b-chat`. Non-streaming. Example SDK estimate they ran:
```js
// client-side estimator output
{ estimated_prompt: 520, estimated_completion: 430, total_estimated: 950 }
```
And the API response usage they received (screenshot) shows:
```json
{"usage": {"prompt_tokens": 650, "completion_tokens": 595, "total_tokens": 1245}}
```

patrick_engineer: Two quick hypotheses: 1) server counts any messages injected by tool/function calls or connector outputs that happen after the client estimate; 2) server-side separators/system-tokenization differences (conversation framing tokens) sometimes add ~10-50 tokens per message depending on model. Do we have the raw request payload (messages array) and whether they used `functions` or `tooling`?

emma_support: Raw messages (sanitized) they sent:
```json
[ {"role":"system","content":"You are a concise assistant."}, {"role":"user","content":"Summarize the report and extract action items."}, {"role":"assistant","content":"Sure, calling report-analyzer tool..."}, {"role":"tool","name":"report-analyzer","content":"<long analysis text approx 300 tokens>"} ]
```
Customer says the tool output is appended by our runtime and they didn't include it in their SDK estimate because it wasn't present at estimate time.

vikram_billing: This matches billing behavior: invoicing is based on server-side tokenization after full response composition, including any `tool`/`function` messages that are produced by runtime plumbing. SDK estimators intentionally only account for client-side message tokens at request time unless tool outputs are explicitly simulated. We try to call that out, but docs could be clearer.

patrick_engineer: Can reproduce quickly: if tool output is returned as a new assistant/tool message, it will be counted in `usage` since billing runs on final transcript. If SDK estimate runs before the tool returns, you get a gap. I'll run a small repro with the same pattern and paste logs.

dev-bot: log: req_id=req_01GkL9XyZ model=redwood-3b-chat final_usage_total=1245 prompt=650 completion=595 extra_tool_tokens=300 event=usage_calculated

vikram_billing: Short term: tell customer the delta is from the report-analyzer tool output which adds ~300 tokens; recommend either 1) simulate expected tool output in estimator; or 2) enable `max_tool_output_tokens` limit on their integration. Long term: I'll open invoice ticket to flag these cases and update billing docs. Creating ticket INV-1392.

patrick_engineer: Action items for eng-runtime: (a) add a deterministic estimator mode that can optionally include hypothetical tool outputs when `return_tool_outputs` is requested; (b) add a debug flag that returns estimated post-tool token delta in the response for customers to reconcile. Assigning to eng-runtime.

emma_support: Thanks all — I'll update the customer with the explanation and ask if they'd like help adding a simulated tool output to their estimator. Will close once customer confirms. :thumbsup:
